terms.comment: Of anything alight: a house, a torch, a fire. Also, as in English, of fever, anger and love (ārdēre amōre). Setting something on fire is incendere or ūrere (see burn, set fire to).

phrases.latin: Caput ārsisse Serviō Tulliō dormientī quae historia nōn prōdidit?
phrases.english: What history doesn’t tell how Servius Tullius’s head was on fire while he slept?

sources: Lewis & Short: ardeo
